solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old Greek writer's place, penning line, by bridge

indicators.note: penning means holding inside, as a pen encloses animals, so the line goes within the word for place

parts.note: to place something is to put it down
an arch is a curved bridge span

explanation.surface: A classical author's home, with a line of writing, sits beside a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is read as 'is': the writer is the result of what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Plutarch was the Greek biographer and essayist who wrote the Parallel Lives.

clue.text: Mythical ship sinks below lake slowly

indicators.note: in a down answer, the ship sinking below the lake means it is written after it

parts.note: the Argo carried Jason and the Argonauts

explanation.surface: A legendary vessel goes down slowly beneath a lake's surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Largo is the musical direction for a slow, broad tempo.

clue.text: Jeer during special date is forbidden

indicators.note: during means the jeer is set inside the rearranged date
special here means made into a different, unusual arrangement, so the letters of date are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
boo is a jeer of disapproval

explanation.surface: Booing on a particular day is not allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tabooed is banned by social custom, prohibited from being done or said.

clue.text: Legendary bird eaten by crocodile

indicators.note: the bird sits inside the word crocodile, as if swallowed by it

parts.note: the letters hold the answer at their start after the first C

explanation.surface: A mythical bird ends up as a crocodile's meal.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is a giant mythical bird from Arabian tales such as Sinbad's voyages.

clue.text: Top-quality school form

parts.note: high school, often shortened to just high
a form is a school class or year group

explanation.surface: A school form described as being of the best quality.
explanation.definitionFit: High-class means superior or of excellent standard, like luxury goods.

clue.text: Some idiots ignoring omen

indicators.note: some of the letters, meaning the answer is a run of letters within these words

parts.note: the answer spans the end of idiots and the start of ignoring

explanation.surface: Foolish people pay no attention to a portent.
explanation.definitionFit: A sign can be a portent of what is to come, just like an omen.

clue.text: Son not ill? Excellent!

parts.note: someone not ill is well

explanation.surface: A delighted reaction to hearing a son is healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Swell is dated, chiefly American slang for very good or excellent.

clue.text: Head of Government whips up complaints

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: its first letter is used
to whip up a crowd is to rouse it

explanation.surface: A political leader stirs up grievances.
explanation.definitionFit: Grouses are grumbles or moans, a common informal word for grievances.

clue.text: A heartless religious teacher with cold language

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: without its heart, the central letter of the teacher's title is removed

parts.note: a rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher

explanation.surface: A cruel cleric with a chill speaks some tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabic is the Semitic tongue spoken across North Africa and the Middle East.

clue.text: Fool engaging leaders of English society doesn't stop talking

indicators.note: engaging here means taking in or holding, so the leading letters go inside the fool

parts.note: a goon is a silly person

indicators.note: the leaders are the first letters of the following words

parts.note: their first letters are used

explanation.surface: An idiot who mixes with high society never shuts up.
explanation.definitionFit: To go on is to talk at tedious length, rambling without pause.

clue.text: Old bird in repeated act

indicators.note: repeated means the same word is written again

parts.note: to do is to act

explanation.surface: An old bird performing the same act over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: The dodo is an extinct flightless bird of Mauritius, long gone.

clue.text: Anonymous female star, not so great

parts.note: an ace is an expert or star performer
less means smaller or not as great

explanation.surface: An unnamed woman celebrity, rather lesser than claimed.
explanation.definitionFit: Faceless describes someone with no identity or individuality, such as nameless bureaucrats.

clue.text: Looking ahead for potential development area we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the words are spoken aloud and their sound gives the answer

parts.note: the word for, taken as said; a site is a plot of land that could be built on

explanation.surface: Planning ahead for an area that could be developed.
explanation.definitionFit: Foresight is the ability to anticipate and plan for the future.

clue.text: Snake less happy after losing its head!

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter, its head

parts.note: madder can mean angrier, less pleased

explanation.surface: A snake grows angrier after being decapitated.
explanation.definitionFit: The adder is Britain's only venomous snake, also known as the viper.

clue.text: A hatter is mad, essentially

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: mad means crazed, wild, so the letters are thrown into a wild new order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Echoes Alice in Wonderland's Mad Hatter, declaring that he is fundamentally insane.
explanation.definitionFit: At heart means fundamentally, in one's real nature.

clue.text: Reference book eventually cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter is chopped off

parts.note: at last means eventually, finally

explanation.surface: A reference work that in the end gets abridged.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a book of maps, a standard work of reference.

clue.text: Party's travails

definitions.meaning: first meaning: belonging to Labour, the UK political party
second meaning: toils or hard work, as a plural noun

explanation.walkthrough: The Labour Party is one of the two main British political parties.
explanation.definitionFit: Labours is both the possessive of the party name and a plural noun for hard efforts.

clue.text: Bits of hymns in church old vicar finally employs

indicators.note: finally means the last letter is taken

parts.note: its last letter is used
to employ is to use

explanation.surface: An elderly clergyman makes use of parts of hymns in church.
explanation.definitionFit: Choruses are the repeated refrains sung between the verses of a hymn or song.

clue.text: Wet home bathed in bit of sunshine

indicators.note: bathed in means enveloped by, so home goes within the beam

parts.note: a ray is a single beam of light
in means at home

explanation.surface: A wet house is nonetheless bathed in some sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainy weather is wet weather, with showers falling.

clue.text: Ruin work of art?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to break or wreck, as a verb
second meaning: a sculpture of head and shoulders

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark hints that the surface's damaged artwork is really two separate senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Bust is both a verb for breaking something and a noun for a sculpted head and chest.

clue.text: Sun's to rise with a hint of light being introduced

indicators.note: introduced means brought in, so the hint goes inside the verb

parts.note: to soar is to rise high

indicators.note: a hint is just a trace, the first letter

parts.note: its first letter is used

explanation.surface: The sun is about to come up, giving the first glimmer of light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sun's' is the definition as an adjective, meaning of the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Solar means relating to the sun, so a solar eclipse is the sun's eclipse.

clue.text: Arrangement of chairs, first put out for dining

indicators.note: the opening letter is removed, put outside the word

parts.note: seating is the placement of chairs at a function

explanation.surface: Laying out chairs, then removing the top one, ready for a dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Eating and dining both mean having a meal.

clue.text: Success obtained by the French pair

parts.note: a coup is a notable success or triumph
le is the French masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A French couple has pulled off a triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple is two of something, especially two people together.

clue.text: Loaf of bread for horse

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a sturdy short-legged horse

explanation.walkthrough: A cob is a round loaf in British usage; it is also a stocky riding horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Cob names both a rounded bread loaf and a strong, short-legged breed of horse.

clue.text: Don't go and wander off — not right

indicators.note: not right means without the letter for right, so it is removed

parts.note: to stray is to wander away

explanation.surface: A plea to someone not to leave or drift away, wrongly.
explanation.definitionFit: Stay, as an imperative, asks someone to remain rather than leave.

clue.text: What risk-averse people want, certainly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: cautious people want to be certain
second meaning: an Irish-sounding interjection meaning of course

explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a playful literal reading of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To be sure is an affirmation meaning indeed, and literally states what cautious people seek.
